data.summary: This week, Ethan Qiu made 30 GitHub contributions to UTMIST/Misty, with 18 pushes recorded there. He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Mist#114 and UTMIST/Misty#271 and #284, and reviewed pull requests across UTMIST/Misty and UTMIST/UTMIST, including UTMIST/Misty#206, #259, #261, #262, #264, #266, #280, #281, #282, #283, #286, #287, and #288, plus UTMIST/UTMIST#487 and #489. He also opened issues in UTMIST/Misty#270, #272, #273, #274, #277, #278, and #285, and UTMIST/UTMIST#495.
